output.summary:
Revisit of SPELL.bless at stage C after infra ticket T-25 was fixed (the costed material check now uses the spell's own component item and its GP value). The 44 existing Bless tests from the first pass still pass, and their earlier tickets T-20 to T-23 are fixed. I added 10 tests to tests/srd/test_spells.py, all green:
- #4: the 5 GP boundary (exactly 5 GP works, 4 GP is refused); a 25 GP symbol works; the symbol isn't consumed; abuse tests showing that cheap symbols can't be pooled, a Component Pouch can't top up a cheap symbol, and the cheap-symbol refusal holds through the Session too.
- #7: a spell attack roll (Guiding Bolt from a caster who blessed themself) gets the d4; a damage roll doesn't.
- #8: upcasting with a level-2 slot the caster doesn't have is refused cleanly.
The whole file passes (76 passed) and ruff is clean. No new engine defects. I added two cheats to loop/abuse-catalogue.md: meeting a costed component's price with cheap copies, pooled copies or a pouch top-up, and upcasting with a slot level you don't have. Paladin casting and slots of level 3 and above are out of scope. The R-12, R-13 and R-14 rulings already cover the ambiguities, so no new ones are proposed.

interactions.with: SPELL.casting-spells.components.material-m (Component Pouch / Spellcasting Focus can't replace a costed component)
interactions.note: The T-25 change: the cost check now reads the item's price. Tested with symbols worth 4, 5 and 25 GP, pooled cheap symbols, and a pouch plus a cheap symbol.

interactions.with: Holy Symbol item (equipment price 5 GP, cost prop)
interactions.note: JOZAN carries two symbols (class kit and background). Each test sets up exactly the symbols it needs.
Losing Concentration, or starting a second Concentration spell, ends Bless on every target. Covered by existing tests.
Both get the d4. Covered by existing tests; T-23 is fixed.
A spell attack is an attack roll, so it gets the d4. New test.
None of these get the d4. New test for damage; checks and Initiative were already covered.
Only one d4, whichever d20 is kept. Already covered.
Covered by the Targets unit tests and by the Bless object-target test.
A level 1 cleric has no level 2 slot. The upcast is refused cleanly. New test.

abuse.case: Meeting the 5 GP price with a 4 GP Holy Symbol
abuse.reason: A costed component must be worth at least the listed price.

abuse.case: Pooling cheap Holy Symbols (3 GP x3) to reach 5 GP
abuse.reason: A single item has to be worth 5+ GP; prices don't add up across items.

abuse.case: Topping up a cheap Holy Symbol with a Component Pouch
abuse.reason: A pouch can't replace a costed component.

abuse.case: Cheap Holy Symbol through the Session command path
abuse.reason: The player-facing path must refuse cleanly too.

abuse.case: Upcasting with a slot level the caster doesn't have to get a fourth target
abuse.reason: Spending a spell slot the caster doesn't have.

abuse.case: Component Pouch or holy water in place of the Holy Symbol; stowing a weapon before the refusal
Going over the target cap / naming a target twice
Keeping Bless with a second Concentration spell
